contexts.text: A speech of Spirits which has a quadruplicate termination...
The red blood... seems to be able to pass through similar gyres as Spirits when inaugurated into a Society; and, in fact, with fourfold terminations.

There are Genii, and also Spirits, who... act and speak with a fourfold sound and speech, so that there are four terminations... When it is quickest it coincides with the fourfold or quadruped sounds of those mentioned elsewhere.
